content.text: Too broad; narrow to non-test source.

The logic is in `lib/utils/credential-formatter.ts`.

- **Detecting activation links:**
  - `isValidActivationUrl` (line 24) checks whether a string is a valid activation URL.
  - `extractActivationUrl` (line 40) searches a credential item for such a URL. It checks string values and also looks inside the item's fields.
  - `isActivationLink` (line 76) is true when a URL was extracted.
  - `getDeliveryKind` (line 86) returns `"activation_link"`, `"account"` or `"access_text"`.
- **Building copyable text:**
  - The function around line 99 builds the copy value for a single unit. For an activation link it returns only the raw URL, with no prefix.
  - The function around line 119 builds the combined text for several units. If every unit is an activation link, it joins the raw links with newlines. Otherwise it handles each unit separately (line 130).

I only read the grep output for this file, not the file itself, so I haven't confirmed the function names around lines 99 and 119.

The UI also imports from `@/src/lib/credential-delivery`: `getDeliveryKind`, `isValidActivationUrl` and `getUnitCopyValue`. `components/public/customer-vault-drawer.tsx` does this at line 40. It also has its own inline check at lines 661–676 that labels a payload "Activation Link" when `isValidActivationUrl` passes. I didn't open `src/lib/credential-delivery`, so I don't know whether it re-exports `lib/utils/credential-formatter.ts` or duplicates it.
